sources.title: Prespa - Ohrid Eco-Region
sources.publication_date_note: No reliable printed publication date was established. Neither the 2021/11 URL directory nor PDF creation metadata is treated as a publication date.
sources.publisher_authority_scope: PONT conservation trust/fund publication; not a governmental naming authority, official registry or legally authoritative naming instrument.
sources.acquisition_outcome: HTTP 200, complete original PDF available for local inspection.

map_locations.scope: Complete one-page map and the full blue-water outlines of all three selected target regions, including southern extremities.

sources.short_label_scope: The literal Lake Ohrid and Prespa Lake wording occurs within partial conservation overlays inside corresponding blue-water basins. Each motivates only a low-confidence geographic naming candidate. These conservation-area labels do not directly establish name coverage over an entire selected water polygon, legal status or governmental naming authority. Great Prespa and Small Prespa remain unverified.
sources.legend_interpretation: Blue fill denotes lakes. Green conservation hatching, proposed-park outlines, dashed wider intervention limits and black international borders are separate map layers.
sources.source_limit: Single conservation-fund map, with no independent naming-source corroboration. It supports generalized whole-outline comparison, not exact current shorelines or official naming status.

independence_note: One PONT map only. Its repeated lake or protected-area labels do not count as independent sources. Failed auxiliary acquisitions contribute no visual evidence.

availability_scope_note: The usable PONT map has full target-area coverage. All three bounded visual assessments are complete despite four failed auxiliary publication acquisitions. Two low-confidence geographic candidates remain on naming-extent/authority holds and the smaller southeastern lake remains a null-candidate name-scope hold. None is access-pending.
included_evidence_limit: Included records retain bibliography, own factual observations and selected geometry facts. Source publications and inspection materials are excluded. Public offline validation checks included records and geometry; it does not reproduce visual map judgments.
